archive.catalogue_description: Description Hi there, this is my first map. Tunnelrat is prototype zombie map stylished by canals. You are running from dead Berlin Bank and then you see how undead surround you. So, You’ve seen the big heavy doors and run into them. You’ve closed them, but you’re in the canals. Welcome in the tunnels, rats. Credits ———– Tom bmx = Music player Joeybbb = For responding and surviving my questions like, what is this and that (I think you have good nerves ) ZM Forums = For really big help (I think I would not do it without you, guys ) Known things and bugs: If you will go behind that signs zombies stops, but they soon recover from this. Beware of rushing into the debris. You can stuck in them. If you find any bug, tell me about it please. Enjoy. This map includes secret armory STRONGLY RECOMMEND PLAYING THIS MAP WITH SOME FRIENDS

notes: Ships 2 executable(s): $PLUGINSDIR/System.dll, $PLUGINSDIR/nsDialogs.dll. NEVER RUN THEM (dev-box.md rule 3). No finish found by name. Before accepting Round 20, someone should glance at this map's own triggers: music_box_player.
